'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***Two [[Palestinian]] children are killed in an [[Israel]]i [[drone attack]] as they were gathering [[firewood]] in the town of [[Bani Suheila]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. **Two [[China|Chinese]] citizens are shot and killed in an [[ambush]] by unidentified gunmen in [[Badakhshan Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://timesofislamabad.com/01-Dec-2025/two-chinese-nationals-shot-dead-in-badakhshan-ambush-in-afghanistan-claims-afghan-journalists (Times of Islamabad)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Ditwah]]
***The toll from the [[landslide]]s caused by heavy rains in [[Sri Lanka]] increases to 132 people killed, 191 missing, 44,000 more displaced, and 15,000 houses destroyed. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/cyclone-ditwah-location-tracker-live-updates-heavy-rainfall-tamil-nadu-chennai-andhra-pradesh-weather-imd-101764387755050.html?id=101764397548333&utm_source=ht_site_copyURL&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ht_site (''Hindustan Times'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/29/sri-lanka-seeks-foreign-help-as-cyclone-ditwah-death-toll-reaches-123 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Cyclone Senyar]]
***The death toll from the [[flood]]s in [[Indonesia]] increases to 303 people. Two more people are confirmed killed in [[Malaysia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/29/indonesia-death-toll-rises-to-248-after-catastrophic-flooding-in-sumatra (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**[[2025 Stockton shooting]]
***Four people are killed and ten others injured in a [[mass shooting]] during a family gathering at a banquet hall in [[Stockton, California|Stockton]], [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nbclosangeles.com/news/shooting-in-stockton-leaves-several-people-hospitalized/3809962/ (ABC News)]
*[[Human rights in Tunisia]]
**[[Tunisia]]n police detain [[National Salvation Front (Tunisia)|National Salvation Front]] member [[Chaima Issa]] in [[Tunis]] to enforce a 20-year prison sentence after an [[appellate court]] recently issued prison terms of up to 45 years against several [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] leaders on charges of [[Criminal conspiracy|plotting]] to [[Coup d'état|overthrow]] the [[President of Tunisia|president]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tunisian-police-arrest-prominent-opposition-figure-chaima-issa-enforce-20-year-2025-11-29/ (Reuters)]
*Seven people are killed and five others are injured when armed attackers open fire inside a bar in [[Tula de Allende]], [[Hidalgo (state)|Hidalgo]], [[Mexico]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/rest-of-world/gunmen-open-fire-at-bar-in-central-mexico-seven-killed-five-critically-injured-probe-launched/articleshow/125667474.cms (AFP via ''Times of India'')]
*The offices of the Italian newspaper ''[[La Stampa]]'' in Turin are stormed by pro-Palestinian protesters. [https://www.rainews.it/articoli/2025/11/il-quotidiano-la-stampa-occupato-dai-pro-pal--519eba82-392f-4c70-bffd-246ff1466500.html (RAI)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état]]
**[[Guinea-Bissau]]'s [[High Military Command for the Restoration of National Security and Public Order|military junta]] installs a 28-member [[provisional government]] after seizing power, while ousted [[President of Guinea-Bissau|president]] [[Umaro Sissoco Embaló]] travels to [[Brazzaville]], [[Republic of the Congo]], where he intends [[Exile|to stay]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20251129-ousted-guinea-bissau-president-arrives-in-brazzaville-congolese-sources (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Human rights in Nicaragua]]
**[[Nicaragua]] releases about 40 [[political prisoner]]s, who are transferred to [[house arrest]] and required to report to authorities. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/nicaraguan-authorities-release-about-40-political-critics-prison-political-2025-11-29/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 AFL Women's season]]
**[[2025 AFL Women's Grand Final]]
***In [[women's Australian rules football]], the [[North Melbourne Football Club#Women's teams|North Melbourne Tasmanian Kangaroos]] defeats the [[Brisbane Lions#AFL Women's team|Brisbane Lions]] in the [[AFL Women's Grand Final|grand final]] by 40 points to win their second premiership in a row. North Melbourne's [[half-back line|half-back]] [[Eilish Sheerin]] is voted [[Norm Goss Memorial Medal|best-on-ground]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-11-01/north-melbourne-makes-history-with-24th-consecutive-aflw-win/105960520 (ABC News Australia)] 
*[[2025 Copa Libertadores]]
**[[2025 Copa Libertadores final]]
***In [[association football]], [[Flamengo]] defeats fellow [[Football in Brazil|Brazilians]] [[Palmeiras]] 1–0 to win their fourth [[Copa Libertadores]] title, becoming the most successful Brazilian club in the [[Football in South America|continental]] competition.
